description: This Java class defines an immutable data transfer object (DTO) representing a Fixed Deposit product in the Apache Fineract financial platform. The class extends DepositProductData and includes additional fields specific to fixed deposits, such as pre-closure penalties, deposit terms, and amount limits. It provides static factory methods for creating instances with various configurations, including templates and account details.

classes.name: FixedDepositProductData
classes.description: Immutable data object representing a Fixed Deposit product, extending DepositProductData with additional fixed deposit-specific fields such as pre-closure penalties, deposit term limits, and amounts.

methods.name: template
methods.description: Creates a template FixedDepositProductData instance with default values and provided options for dropdowns.

methods.name: withCharges
methods.description: Returns a new FixedDepositProductData instance with specified charges replacing existing ones.

methods.name: withTemplate
methods.description: Creates a new FixedDepositProductData using an existing one, populated with template options for dropdown fields.

methods.name: withAccountingDetails
methods.description: Creates a new FixedDepositProductData with specific accounting mappings and account-related info.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Constructs a FixedDepositProductData instance based on an existing DepositProductData and additional fixed deposit-specific parameters.

methods.name: lookup
methods.description: Creates a FixedDepositProductData object with minimal info, primarily used for referencing or lookup purposes.

methods.name: withInterestChart
methods.description: Returns an updated FixedDepositProductData containing specified interest rate charts.
